question: What runs from Kurma to Fish, and what do pithas mean?
premises: by yuga-sequence the siddha-line runs Kurma to Fish
inference: The siddha continuum spans ages; adi-words mark sacred sites.
uncertainties: kUrma-to-mIna as yuga-span kept per gloss
plain_english: By yuga-sequence the siddha-continuum from Kurma to Fish — and by the word beginning: house, village, pithas and sub-pithas.
